name: Alight (ALIT)
teaser: At $8.60 the shares trade 20.0% below my conditional Base value of $10.75, an upside of 25.0%. The discount is thin because Alight owes about $2.0 billion to banks and $463 million under a tax receivable agreement against a market value of $246 million, so a small change in the business moves the shares a lot. The company reported $101 million of free cash flow in the first half, but after the tax payments it also made, the cash left for shareholders was minus $55 million. Refinancing of the 2028 debt was not agreed as of October 14, and the price and funding of the Abett acquisition are not disclosed. Confidence is D and the required margin of safety is 50%, which gives an indicative cap of $5.37 and no buy zone. Hold for holders, watchlist for new money. Third quarter results on November 3 are not in this analysis.
llms: Leveraged benefits administration company, valued on owner cash after interest, investment, compensation and tax receivable payments with an enterprise value cross-check; conditional on the pre-Abett business, refinancing of about 2.0 billion dollars of debt is unresolved. Bear 0.00, Base 10.75, Bull 44.61. Verdict HOLD at 8.60 (watchlist, no buy zone).
